body:
Date of experience: 11-5-2024 through 13-5-2024
Experience report was written and edited during and after the experiences, but I never got around to submitting them. In square/arrow <> parenthesis I will indicate any edits made on 28 November 2025.
Background: This is my regular Friday night routine. I smoke weed almost every night. On Fridays I usually smoke a little more than usual. I consume alcohol on Friday and Saturday and occasionally on Thursday if there is a work event with alcohol on that evening that week and Im going (which I usually do).
Reason for writing: Didnt really see the point of writing yet another Weed/Alcohol experience report. As I am planning on taking some more obscure, poorly covered compounds in the future and sharing my experiences with them I thought it could be useful to have a more accessible reference point of how I react to commonly taken drugs. This is also the reason for the weed only and alcohol only reports I will share.
T+0:00: Starting to sip away at 250ml of 12.5% ABV of 2022 white wine Park Villa. I find it tastes quite nice, though I drink for the ethanol not the taste (then Id just go for any of the many alcohol free drinks that taste amazing). Im watching YouTube.
T+0:20: Drank a little over half, tuning in to the YouTube livestream of the new Taskmaster episode (S17E7). Only ~15 minutes remaining, if only Id thought about that when I started drinking
T+0:25: Finish the wine. Starting to feel some looseness coming on. Slight warm body feeling.
T+0:26: As I am more self analysing than Id normally be on such a night I notice I am enjoying the episode noticeably more in comparison to baseline. Also thinking about how much more at ease I feel taking this hard drug because of my familiarity with it, in comparison to the 4fma I tried the day before. A confirmation I suppose, that I fear the unknown, at least in regards to affecting my health short term more than a known risk.
T+0:32: Considering drinking more, decide to wait for the wine Ive already drank to get a chance to be absorbed first so as to not overdo it.
T+1:01: Start rolling my joint. The last 30 minutes were spent watching more videos. Getting a bit annoyed at Jordan Petersons obliviousness to reality. Kinda feel like trying my Methyl-ethyl-tryptamine laced joint. But I dont want to add the effects of a psychedelic to this mix, probably not a great idea anyhow.
Thus the joint rolling. Feeling tipsy. Probably
would
say drunk as the first signs of lowered coordination are noticeable but the state Im in most others would refer to as tipsy I believe.
T+1:13: Almost finished rolling, taking my time (also writing these paragraphs). Watching Beau of the Fifth Column. Very impressed and happy his content exists. Also notice how paying more attention to how Im feeling is altering my experience
paying more attention to how Im feeling is altering my experience
. I normally would occasionally have such realisations whilst on various substances, but Im fairly certain this time all/most of them are caused by the fact Im more introspective than Id normally be had I not been writing this report. I also realise that usually the first few times Im taking a drug at least some amount of time under the influence regardless of writing a report is spent in this introspective state, and thus likely alters quite significantly the experience compared to going into it without the intent of discovering the alterations in my perception it causes.
T+1:19: Finished rolling the joint. Ill be going downstairs and into the garden to smoke now. Will keep notes on my phone instead of my computer from now on. Likely to be shorter simply because of that. Also due to the phone being a less convenient/fast method of typing. I also brought the iPad I purchased two days prior, quite happy with it, which might alter my mood slightly.
T+1:20: Decide to drink ~50ml of the wine (still 12.5% ABV) before smoking. Down it in one. Also feeling before smoking is quite euphoric and calm. Yet I also feel this sense of hyperactivity and impulsivity. But not acting on it nor really any strong desire to do so, yet still very much present. Smoking also feels like a good way to silence this nagging hyperactive element. I decided to watch another episode of The Office on my iPad while smoking.
T+1:21: Start of smoking ~0.4g of weed
T+1:27: Weed more philosophical than alcohol - Dont remember what I was thinking about exactly anymore. But I often get into this philosophical mindset early on when smoking weed. Like to quietly
talk to myself to process those thoughts more effectively. Something in S1E2 of The Office (US) caused the philosophising, probably something related to race.
T+1:38: Feeling calm and horny - Right after I finished smoking and made my way back upstairs. Calmness is the norm, sometimes its anxiety, more rare than it used to be when I was younger. In those cases anxiety goes away after 15-30 minutes. Horniness is less common than it used to be. I was a little surprised by it.
T+1:42: Really bad dry mouth - Did not last that long as I remember, was that bad for 5-10 minutes. General dry mouth throughout though.
T+1:46: finish episode s1e2 of the office, masturbate
T+2:03: finish [masturbating], [go to watch] youtube
T+2:12: vision shook in x-axis for 2-3 minutes - This is abnormal for me. Weed used to increase my very minor HPPD-like distortions (slightly vibrating edges, CEVs, slight alterations in perceived hue). As Ive not done psychs in a while this has essentially disappeared
Weed used to increase my very minor HPPD-like distortions (slightly vibrating edges, CEVs, slight alterations in perceived hue). As Ive not done psychs in a while this has essentially disappeared
, only occasionally being present in a very mild/minor/subtle form. The vibrations in my vision did not concern me, they didnt make things harder to do (like read), it was slightly distracting though. [Still having yet to return to psychedelics/hallucinogenics I only still have vibrating edges when high or very tired]
T+2:21: smoke a little bit more - Was around 0.1g
T+2:26: done, eat chips and yt - Was done smoking ~0.1g, decided to eat some chips (eat ~160g) whilst watching youtube.
This is where the notes end. After the chips I switched to an Ace Attorney lets play by RTGame. I always watch it when going to sleep, Ive found it makes it easier to get my mind at rest this way.
According to Sleep Cycle I fell asleep at around T+3:00*
Next day there was no hangover. Was sleepy/groggy for most of the day, but from experience I know this is because I choose to stay in bed after waking up for too long. No physical discomfort at all. I found out there were northern lights visible, but I didn't see it because I didnt know.
Notes: For the formatting of the part where I was high, I also became a little lazy. So in quotes is the exact note as I typed it into my phone, followed by a description I wrote the day after elaborating what I meant with those notes.
Another weed+alcohol experience (the next night)
===
T+0:00 Start drinking 12.5% ABV white wine, 230ml, same as yesterday, wine was not stored cooled, tastes slightly less sweet, not yet acidic, probably lower ABV already though. Plan on viewing the northern lights if able to whilst smoking later tonight. (22:05 is the starting time)
T+0:18: Getting frustrated with Siri and Perplexity AI. At least perplexity AI is a little better than Siri, so some progress is being made Drank about 125ml by now.
T+0:25: Finish the wine. Enjoying youtube videos. Looking forward to the potential of northern lights.
T+0:41: Notice feeling of looseness. Movements are less precise though still under full control. More relaxed/at ease when compared to baseline. Prepare materials to roll a joint. Why did I not do it before drinking, it would be slightly easier that way
T+1:02: Need to pee, likely due to alcohol consumption, crows grieving/death rituals are fascinating
. Finally mostly dark outside (astronomical twilight)
T+1:13: Decide to go outside, finish rolling (a nicely done) joint somewhere after T+1:02. Decided to also take my MET laced joint with me just in case. I doubt Ill use it, but maybe if the northern lights are truly something I might. That is of course if I get to see them at all, as the reports said one had to be patient to see them. I could of course get lucky though. Well see.
T+1:17: finally peed, remembered I should find some podcast so as to not have too much light around, decide super carlin brothers should work.
T+1:25 light pollution disgusting, take walk to darker area to see of I can see more stars, which should be a good measure
.
T+1:34: downloaded night camera app as to be able to see if too subtle to notice without eyes being used to it. Works well. Just long exposure but still. Shows more clearly what I saw, which is the sky is brighter, not colourful at all, don't know why, maybe slightly more cloudy and the light pollution.
T+1:42: light up (non laced)
T+1:43: sky appears more blue
T+1:44: long exposure photo doesn't seem to show it, will analyse tomorrow.
T+1:54: Finish smoking. 0.4g. A little too stoned. Want to lie down. Want to see northern lights. Sit it out.
T+2:04-2:07: got scared a few minutes ago when my neighbour came home. Don't know why really. Got inside quickly and then essentially froze. After doing this mostly thoughtlessly I realise what I'm doing, due to feeling anxious. I go into the living room and turn on the lights, and the anxiety quickly dissipates and I'm calm once again. I look up my current T value from my timer and start writing.
T+2:16: go outside again
T+2:18: smoke
T+2:21: done, 0.2g
T+2:25: go to bed not yet to sleep, look out of window first
T+2:29: going to watch yt until natural fall asleep, will start sleep tracker
T+3:01: Fall asleep according to Sleep Cycle app*.
*: I set an alarm with Stop Playing to make sure the video I watch while falling asleep doesnt keep playing too long. In all recordings the time I feel straight into Deep Sleep according to the app line up quite nicely with the time the video would have stopped playing. As the app uses the microphone its quite possible I fell asleep earlier than reported in both cases.
Yet another night of Weed+Alcohol (again the next night)
===
T+0:00: Start drinking the same wine again 12.5% ABV, ~230ml. Taste has got a bitter hint, even less sweet, still not acidic. (21:50) Tomorrow is a work day, so I will smoke weed around 22:30 and try to fall asleep before/around 0:00. YouTube again.
T+0:02: start rolling early
T+0:03: As Im getting the materials I see I still have some cones left, feeling lazy so Ill just fill it instead of rolling a j.
T+0:19: Finished grinding and filling cone, took longer because got distracted by wanting to watch porn. Did not yet masturbate, will do so now. Video is weird, dont get what is hot about starting to fuck someone who is asleep. Would be very uncomfortable if it wasnt so clearly acted.
is hot though!
T+0:29: Finish masturbating, continue watching the youtube video about remote controls I was watching before, need
to smoke soon. Stopped drinking at around T+0:05, continuing that as well, looks like I drank around 50ml at first, now drinking the rest.
T+0:35: Drank the rest of the wine. Going to smoke very soon now, will probably hit hard as both will start meaningfully impacting me at about the same time. Currently the feeling of looseness is not yet present. Clearly under the influence of alcohol though, warm, subtle feelings of calm and euphoria.
